questions.text: Which country is famous for being shaped like a boot on the map?
questions.explanation: Italy's peninsula is widely likened to a boot kicking Sicily.

questions.text: Which ocean shares its name with a large South Asian country?
questions.explanation: The Indian Ocean is named after India.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Canada?
questions.explanation: Queen Victoria chose Ottawa as the capital in 1857, before confederation.

questions.text: Which is the longest river in South America?
questions.explanation: The Amazon is far longer than any other South American river.

questions.text: Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak, is in which country?
questions.explanation: Kilimanjaro rises in northeastern Tanzania near the Kenyan border.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was purpose-built as the national capital.

questions.text: Which strait separates Spain from Morocco at the western end of the Mediterranean?
questions.explanation: The Strait of Gibraltar links the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.

questions.text: Which African country was formerly known to Europeans as Abyssinia?
questions.explanation: Abyssinia was the historical European name for Ethiopia.

questions.text: Lake Titicaca lies on the border of Peru and which other country?
questions.explanation: Lake Titicaca is shared by Peru and Bolivia.

questions.text: Which desert stretches across southern Mongolia and northern China?
questions.explanation: The Gobi is a vast cold desert in East Asia.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara replaced Istanbul as capital in 1923.

questions.text: Which river flows through the city of Baghdad?
questions.explanation: Baghdad lies on the banks of the Tigris.

questions.text: Which is the smallest independent country in the world by area?
questions.explanation: Vatican City covers only about 0.44 square kilometres.

questions.text: Which is the deepest lake in the world?
questions.explanation: Siberia's Lake Baikal reaches roughly 1,640 metres deep.

questions.text: The Strait of Malacca separates the Malay Peninsula from which large island?
questions.explanation: Sumatra lies across the Strait of Malacca from Malaysia.

spares.text: On which continent is the Sahara desert found?
spares.explanation: The Sahara covers much of northern Africa.

spares.text: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
spares.explanation: Wellington sits at the southern tip of the North Island.

spares.text: Timbuktu, the historic trading city, is in which country?
spares.explanation: Timbuktu lies near the Niger River in Mali.
